name: Lallu Prasath
bio: Lallu Prasath is an Indian film Actor and lyricist, who has worked predominantly in Tamil movie industry.

credits.title: Con City
credits.overview: Saravana, Mithra, Jacky, and Janaki, are skilled con artists hiding out as an ordinary family in Mulki, Karnataka. Their quiet life shatters when a young boy in their care is kidnapped, forcing them to use their old hustles one last time.

credits.title: Madraskaaran
credits.overview: A minor argument between two strangers escalates into a life-altering conflict, exploring how a seemingly insignificant event can drastically alter a person's perception and circumstances.

credits.title: Amaran
credits.overview: A heroic true story of Major Mukund Varadarajan, an Indian Army officer who displayed extraordinary bravery during a counterterrorism mission in Kashmir’s Shopian district. The film captures his courage in protecting his nation and the devotion of his wife Indhu Rebecaa Varghese.

credits.title: Siren
credits.overview: After being in jail for 14 years, Thilagavarman gets out of prison on parole. A cat-and-mouse chase unfolds as Nandhini, a tainted police officer zeroes in on him as suspect in a spate of murders

credits.title: Master
credits.overview: An alcoholic professor is sent to a juvenile school, where he clashes with a gangster, who uses the children of the school for criminal activities.

credits.title: Dharala Prabhu
credits.overview: An energetic youngster Prabhu who is approached by a fertility clinic to donate his sperm and make some quick money, isn't aware of how this decision might affect his future.

credits.title: Naan Sirithal
credits.overview: A man suffers from a condition where he laughs uncontrollably under stressful conditions and it causes a lot of trouble for him until he seeks a strong solution for it.

credits.title: Sangathamizhan
credits.overview: A village is protesting against the setting up a copper plant, but when their leader dies, the corporate company behind the plant sends in a look-alike to facilitate their plan.

credits.title: Kaithi
credits.overview: Dilli, a convicted criminal, is out on parole to meet his daughter. However, a drug bust sets him off on a mission to save the life of police officers.

credits.title: Ayogya
credits.overview: A corrupt inspector Karnan reforms and strives for justice after a life-altering event prompts a change of heart

credits.title: Sarkar
credits.overview: NRI corporate Sundar Ramasamy comes to India to vote, only to learn that his vote has already been cast. While he reclaims his right legally, it also sets in motion a chain of events that eventually lead to him entering the political fray, trying to change the system.

credits.title: Rangoon
credits.overview: The life of three youngsters, who go to Rangoon to strike a business deal, witnesses several twists and turns, for which they pay heavy price.

credits.title: 8 Thottakkal
credits.overview: A cop’s pistol gets stolen and even as the search for it gets underway, it ends up in the hands of someone who uses it to rob a bank.

credits.title: Chennai 600028 II: Second Innings
credits.overview: A group of friends reunite for the wedding of one of their own. However, when a mishap threatens to ruin the event, only a series of cricket matches can save the day.

credits.title: Kathai Thiraikathai Vasanam Iyakkam
credits.overview: A scriptwriter calls his friends over for a discussion to create a script for his first film. The group consists of a cinematographer, a director-wannabe with 40 years of experience and three young assistant directors.
